label: Figma
description: Official Figma OAuth integration for design files, rendered nodes, and comments.

apps.label: Figma
apps.description: Read files and nodes, render images, and work with Figma comments.

connectPrompt: Connect Figma to inspect files and nodes, render images, and work with comments.

tools.name: figma_get_me
tools.description: Get the current Figma user. When multiple Figma accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Figma account email or identifier.

tools.name: figma_get_file
tools.description: Read a Figma file JSON document. When multiple Figma accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Figma account email or identifier.

tools.name: figma_get_file_nodes
tools.description: Read specific nodes from a Figma file. When multiple Figma accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Figma account email or identifier.

tools.name: figma_get_file_images
tools.description: Render Figma nodes to image URLs. When multiple Figma accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

format.description: jpg, png, svg, or pdf. Default png.

account_email.description: Optional connected Figma account email or identifier.

tools.name: figma_get_comments
tools.description: List comments on a Figma file. When multiple Figma accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Figma account email or identifier.

tools.name: figma_post_comment
tools.description: Post a Figma file comment. When multiple Figma accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Figma account email or identifier.

tools.name: figma_api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Figma REST API request for advanced file, comment, library, variable, webhook, and dev resource operations. When multiple Figma accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.

account_email.description: Optional connected Figma account email or identifier.
